text.title: We value your privacy
text.body: We use essential cookies and similar technologies to operate, secure, and provide core website features. These technologies remain active because they are necessary for the website to function. With your permission, we also use optional technologies to analyze website traffic, personalize content, and support advertising. Select Accept All to allow optional technologies, Reject All to use only those necessary for website functionality, or Customize to manage your preferences.
text.prefsIntro: We use cookies to help you navigate efficiently and perform certain functions. You will find detailed information about all cookies under each consent category below.
text.gpcConfirmation: Your Global Privacy Control opt-out signal was detected and honored.
text.dnsLabel: Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information
text.dnsConfirmation: You have opted out of the sale/sharing of your personal information.

essential.label: Necessary
essential.description: Necessary cookies are required to enable the basic features of this site, such as providing secure log-in or adjusting your consent preferences. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable data.

functional.label: Functional
functional.description: Functional cookies help perform certain functionalities like sharing the content of the website on social media platforms, collecting feedback, and other third-party features.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: Analytical cookies are used to understand how visitors interact with the website. These cookies help provide information on metrics such as the number of visitors, bounce rate, traffic source, etc.

marketing.label: Advertisement
marketing.description: Advertisement cookies are used to provide visitors with customized advertisements based on the pages you visited previously and to analyze the effectiveness of the ad campaigns.

cookies.name: PHPSESSID
cookies.description: This cookie is native to PHP applications. The cookie stores and identifies a user's unique session ID to manage user sessions on the website. The cookie is a session cookie and will be deleted when all the browser windows are closed.

cookies.name: rc::a
cookies.description: This cookie is set by the Google recaptcha service to identify bots to protect the website against malicious spam attacks.

cookies.name: __Secure-YEC
cookies.description: YouTube sets this cookie to stores the user's video player preferences using embedded YouTube video

cookies.name: TS01*
cookies.description: Wix sets this cookie for security and anti-fraud purposes.

cookies.name: XSRF-TOKEN
cookies.description: This cookie enhances visitor browsing security by preventing cross-site request forgery.

cookies.name: VISITOR_PRIVACY_METADATA
cookies.description: YouTube sets this cookie to manage feature rollout and experimentation. It helps Google control which new features or interface changes are shown to users as part of testing and staged rollouts, ensuring consistent experience for a given user during an experiment.

cookies.name: YSC
cookies.description: YSC cookie is set by Youtube and is used to track the views of embedded videos on Youtube pages.

cookies.name: VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE
cookies.description: A cookie set by YouTube to measure bandwidth that determines whether the user gets the new or old player interface.

cookies.name: yt-remote-connected-devices
cookies.description: YouTube sets this cookie to store the user's video preferences using embedded YouTube videos.

cookies.name: ytidb::LAST_RESULT_ENTRY_KEY
cookies.description: The cookie ytidb::LAST_RESULT_ENTRY_KEY is used by YouTube to store the last search result entry that was clicked by the user. This information is used to improve the user experience by providing more relevant search results in the future.

cookies.name: yt-remote-device-id
cookies.description: YouTube sets this cookie to store the user's video preferences using embedded YouTube videos.

cookies.name: yt-remote-session-name
cookies.description: The yt-remote-session-name cookie is used by YouTube to store the user's video player preferences using embedded YouTube video.

cookies.name: yt-remote-fast-check-period
cookies.description: The yt-remote-fast-check-period cookie is used by YouTube to store the user's video player preferences for embedded YouTube videos.

cookies.name: yt-remote-session-app
cookies.description: The yt-remote-session-app cookie is used by YouTube to store user preferences and information about the interface of the embedded YouTube video player.

cookies.name: yt-remote-session-app
cookies.description: The yt-remote-session-app cookie is used by YouTube to store user preferences and information about the interface of the embedded YouTube video player.

cookies.name: yt-remote-cast-available
cookies.description: The yt-remote-cast-installed cookie is used to store the user's video player preferences using embedded YouTube video.

cookies.name: cookie-law-info
cookies.description: Stores the user's cookie consent preferences.

cookies.name: _ckyGcm
cookies.description: Stores the Google Consent Mode state used by Buzznerd consent.

cookies.name: _userway_
cookies.description: UserWay accessibility widget

cookies.name: _userway_
cookies.description: UserWay accessibility widget

cookies.name: _userway_
cookies.description: UserWay accessibility widget

cookies.name: WooCommerce Cart Fragments
cookies.description: Loads WooCommerce cart fragments to refresh cart contents and update the mini cart using AJAX.

cookies.name: woocommerce-menu-cart
cookies.description: Used by the WooCommerce Menu Cart functionality to update the cart via AJAX. This website does not use cart or checkout functionality, so this script is manually blocked before user consent.

cookies.name: algolia_user_token_1
cookies.description: Description is currently not available.

cookies.name: _ga_*
cookies.description: Google Analytics sets this cookie to store and count page views.

cookies.name: _ga
cookies.description: Google Analytics sets this cookie to calculate visitor, session and campaign data and track site usage for the site's analytics report. The cookie stores information anonymously and assigns a randomly generated number to recognise unique visitors.

cookies.name: rc::c
cookies.description: This cookie is set by the Google recaptcha service to identify bots to protect the website against malicious spam attacks.

cookies.name: __Secure-ROLLOUT_TOKEN
cookies.description: YouTube sets this cookie to manage feature rollout and experimentation. It helps Google control which new features or interface changes are shown to users as part of testing and staged rollouts, ensuring consistent experience for a given user during an experiment.

cookies.name: NID
cookies.description: Stores user preferences and supports Google services such as Maps, reCAPTCHA, or embedded content. May also be used for ad personalization depending on context.
